title: Form
description: Embeds a published Cradle form. Server-rendered <form method="post"> that works without JavaScript; the view script cradle-forms-view submits it in place with fetch() to the REST route. Select the form by formId, or by formSlug (its address name, ^[a-z0-9-]{1,200}$, for theme templates where IDs differ per site; formId wins). With Cradle Languages active, the form's translation in the current language is rendered when it exists (a slug resolves to the default-language form first).
